events.text: Follow-up commit 973343fe1: the hovered red box in the screenshot was the whole-face CELL — at 2u (~12.5cm) cells a small gun face is smaller than one cell, so it collapsed to a single cell with no interior grid. Fixed: (1) PAINT_CELL_UNITS 2→0.5 (~3cm) so prop faces show a real grid (GRID_MAX caps huge faces; only painted cells render); (2) added FILL mode — a 'fill' toggle in the PaintPanel makes one click paint the WHOLE face one colour (the 'just one colour per face' path, cell-size-independent). Build clean; meshPaint 8/8 (count test pinned to explicit 2u/cell).

resolution: Fixed 'I'm in paint mode with a colour but see no grid lines and nothing paints'. Root cause: there was no cursor poll — a Pressable's onMouseMove only fires while a mouse button is HELD (engine.zig gates .move on dragging_left), so a free-moving cursor delivered no hover, paintProbe never ran, and the grid overlay (which reads paintHoverRef) had nothing to show. I'd ported the painter but not the hover-poll fix the demos use. Added a paint-mode cursor pump that polls getMouseX/getMouseY every 33ms and calls paintProbe for the hovered face/cell (probeRef keeps tex/camSnap fresh since the effect runs once per mode change); outside the viewport it clears the hover. Verified out-of-band that pickFaceCell + faceCellGrid resolve on a TEXTUREIZED mesh (6/6 cuboid faces get valid 16×16 grids, centre ray hits face 3 cell 8,8) — so press-and-drag painting already worked; this restores the missing hover grid so you can see the cells before painting. Builds clean. Needs rjit dev to confirm the live hover visually. shas 1ef84ed9c.
